scientific limitations/integrity: The theorem concerns a specified dependent leave-one-fold-out Gaussian reuse rule, not the published HulC algorithm. Exact finite-sample formulas require iid Gaussian fold means and equal fold sizes. Classical equicorrelated-normal orthant theory supplies a core probability calculation; the claimed contribution is the confidence-hull reuse geometry, its samplewise width collapse, and the resulting sharp coverage asymptotic. No independent audit has been performed.
title: A Gaussian coverage-collapse law for leave-one-fold-out HulC reuse
